en-US.description: Advanced APRS Desktop Client for Windows 10/11 and Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) — built with Electron
en-US.longDescription: Cross-platform desktop client for aprsnet.uk — Windows 10/11 and Debian/Ubuntu Linux. Built with Electron: wraps the full server web UI in a native desktop application with system tray, native OS notifications, GPS positioning, auto member login, two-way filter persistence, real-time settings sync, and persistent appearance settings.
en-US.name: APRSNET Desktop
